rules_yaml:
title: Exploitation of CVE-2024-35250 via Kernel Streaming IOCTL Requests
id: 7b1d8e6c-9f4a-4e67-ba12-3a7d9f1e5c8f
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2024-35250 in Windows kernel streaming drivers by monitoring for access to kernel streaming device drivers with specific IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY requests that indicate privilege escalation activity.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2024/12/cisa-and-fbi-raise-alerts-on-exploited.html
    - https://devco.re/blog/2024/08/23/streaming-vulnerabilities-from-windows-kernel-proxying-to-kernel-part1-en/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1068
logsource:
    category: process_access
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetImage|endswith:
            - '\ksthunk.sys'
            - '\ks.sys'
        SourceImage|endswith: '\MSKSSRV.exe'
        GrantedAccess|contains:
            - '0x1000'
            - '0x1410'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system processes accessing kernel streaming drivers
    - System maintenance or diagnostic tools using kernel streaming APIs
level: high

rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via Mikrotik Router Compromise with Winbox Loader
id: 3e0d7a2c-8f9b-4b6d-9d1a-5e2c8f1b7a3d
status: experimental
description: Detects the initial access phase where an attacker compromises a Mikrotik router and uses Winbox Loader to place a malicious ipv4.dll file in the AppData directory, which is used for subsequent execution.
references:
    - https://securelist.com/apt-slingshot/84312/
    - https://media.kasperskycontenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/43/2018/03/09133534/The-Slingshot-APT_report_ENG_final.pdf
    - https://github.com/Neo23x0/signature-base/blob/master/yara/apt_slingshot.yar
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/web-sas-2018-apt-announcement-2/21514/
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/about/press-releases/slingshot
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1078.001
    - attack.t1566.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '%AppData%\Roaming\mikrotik\winbox'
            - '%AppData%\Roaming\Mikrotik\Winbox'
        CommandLine|endswith: '\ipv4.dll'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Mikrotik management tools or scripts placing files in AppData
level: high

title: Execution of Malicious ipv4.dll Connecting to Hardcoded C2 IP/Port
id: bdd54d9d-d3c3-4dc5-b3b3-96595a74b823
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the malicious ipv4.dll file that connects to a hardcoded IP address (192.168.88.1) and port (4443) to download additional components, indicating command and control communication.
references:
    - https://securelist.com/apt-slingshot/84312/
    - https://media.kasperskycontenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/43/2018/03/09133534/The-Slingshot-APT_report_ENG_final.pdf
    - https://github.com/Neo23x0/signature-base/blob/master/yara/apt_slingshot.yar
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/web-sas-2018-apt-announcement-2/21514/
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/about/press-releases/slingshot
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\ipv4.dll'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '192.168.88.1'
            - ':4443'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Other processes using hardcoded IPs or ports for legitimate purposes
level: high

title: Initial Access via Mikrotik Router Compromise with Winbox Loader
id: 3e0d7a2c-8f9b-4b6d-9d1a-5e2c8f1b7a3d
status: experimental
description: Detects the initial access phase where an attacker compromises a Mikrotik router and uses Winbox Loader to place a malicious ipv4.dll file in the AppData directory, which is used for subsequent execution.
references:
    - https://securelist.com/apt-slingshot/84312/
    - https://media.kasperskycontenthub.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/43/2018/03/09133534/The-Slingshot-APT_report_ENG_final.pdf
    - https://github.com/Neo23x0/signature-base/blob/master/yara/apt_slingshot.yar
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/blog/web-sas-2018-apt-announcement-2/21514/
    - https://www.kaspersky.com/about/press-releases/slingshot
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1078.001
    - attack.t1566.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
